locations.note: Marcus Holloway and DedSec turn San Francisco's new ctOS 2.0 against Blume, ending with Marcus breaking into Blume's San Francisco headquarters to expose its CTO Dušan Nemec.
In the Haum Sweet Haum operation against the smart-home company Haum, Marcus and Wrench head up Sutro Tower.
In the side operation Jailbird Blues, Marcus slips onto Alcatraz to free a witness held there and escapes with the police on his tail.
In Limp Nudle, Horatio, working inside the search giant Nudle, the game's Google, helps Marcus get into its Silicon Valley campus and plant DedSec's malware on its servers.
In Eye for an Eye, Marcus tracks Horatio's killers to the Tezcas gang's house and their armed grow operation in Oakland's Woodland district.
The side operation Paint Job ends with Marcus riding the maintenance lifts up the Golden Gate Bridge to spray four giant graffiti pieces.
